title: Uwell Caliburn G4 Pro Pod Vape Kit
description: The Caliburn G4 Pro upgrades Uwell’s compact G-series with a full touchscreen interface, adjustable power up to 35W and stepless airflow control. A built-in 1800mAh battery supports fast USB-C charging, while the 2.51” touchscreen and on-screen controls make it easy to change wattage, switch modes and reset your puff counter without menus or buttons. You can choose between four output modes: Smart Mode for automatic power matching, Storm Mode for a punchier draw, Waves Mode for a smoother pulsed inhale, and Custom Mode where you can set a 3-stage power curve for each puff. A swipe-down “Smart Settings” hub lets you adjust brightness and screen timeout, toggle animations/battery saver, pick from multiple UI themes, set your language and even rename the device via the on-screen keyboard. The kit uses Uwell’s latest 2ml Caliburn GPP refillable pods with integrated mesh coils in 0.6ohm and 0.4ohm. They fill from the side and incorporate U² anti-leak technology (ultrasonic welding plus a tuned airflow path). The G4 Pro also works with Caliburn G3 pods, giving you broad cross-compatibility across the G Pod Platform. For best results use 50/50 or nicotine salt e-liquids ; high-VG isn’t recommended. An aluminium-alloy body, droplet-shaped e-liquid window and precise airflow slider complete a tidy, stylish, ergonomic and pocket-ready design that suits both new and experienced vapers. We Recommend using the following E-Liquid with these pods: 0.4ohm - Use High VG (sub-ohm) E-Liquids - Choose Double Drip 0.6ohm - Use Nic salt or 50/50 (freebase) E-Liquids - Choose Bar Salts Discover our vape juice and find a flavour that complements this kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
